bt1.engineeringNotes: STATUS CORRECTED (Phase 1D review): APPROVED -> PENDING_ENGINEERING_APPROVAL. An APPROVED status must not imply the battery is safe to issue. BC-G is INDETERMINATE and safety-critical because externalProtectionRequired=true while protectionRating is not recorded, so the engineering verdict is BLOCKED. The standing engineering decision is unchanged: EXTERNAL BATTERY PROTECTION = REQUIRED. The device and rating remain OPEN item D12-E. No value here is invented: mb1 160A is not selected, no other MCCB is selected, and no rating is derived from Ah. The BOM was NOT altered to compensate.
